threads.body: [General] This producer-only metric definition omits `messaging.destination.subscription.name`, but Pulsar still emits that attribute for consumer receive operation durations: `PulsarSingletons.java:92-106` installs `MessagingConsumerMetrics`, `PulsarMessagingAttributesGetter.java:88-92` supplies the subscription, and `MessagingMetricsAdvice.java:66-97` retains it for this histogram. Pointing Pulsar at `dab7c60a` therefore makes the generated list incomplete for receive operations. Please fix the metadata collection so the consumer point is included, then regenerate this file.

[General] The renamed module scope causes the non-v3 controller telemetry to disappear from this generated entry. `JaxrsSingletons` still emits these enabled controller spans under `io.opentelemetry.jaxrs-1.0` outside v3 preview, and both JAX-RS 1 tests assert that path, but the docs parser now filters it out because the module scope is `io.opentelemetry.jaxrs-1.0-annotations`. Add the legacy scope as an allowed scope for this renamed module in the generator (or otherwise model both scopes), then regenerate this file so the `controller-telemetry.enabled=true` case with `code.function`/`code.namespace` remains documented alongside the v3 case.
